name: Westbound Panama Canal "Island / Tropical Dinner" Grilled Mahi-Mahi & Teriyaki Beef Tenderloin
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Westbound Panama Canal (Island / Tropical Menu)
whyItWorks: Exclusive long-voyage Island/Tropical rotation featuring flaky grilled mahi-mahi and sweet-savory teriyaki beef tenderloin over jasmine rice.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the grilled mahi-mahi or beef tenderloin plain with steamed jasmine rice and teriyaki glaze on the side; skip any chunky pineapple-jalapeño salsa.
watchOuts: Skip raw onion/jalapeño fruit salsas on the tropical menu
